title: Braving the Undying Mountain
summary: Hei Huang's teleport lands the group in Wang Kong City, six million li off course, where he mourns a Great Emperor who once stargazed there. They see an unidentified flying object from outer space and chase it toward the Undying Mountain, one of the seven Life Forbidden Zones, where an ancient formation throws them deep inside past the River of Forgetfulness and the Yellow Springs. Nannan wanders unharmed among the Headless Knights and can see the Void Great Emperor's formation lines, which lets her guide them. They find a flayed Sage's skin inscribed with the first volume of the Heavenly Court's divine killing art, then the Ancient Enlightenment Tea Tree, where an afterimage of a Great Emperor (Hei Huang suggests Wu Shi) appears; they strip leaves before the tree runs off. Surrounded by Headless Knights, they escape through the Void Emperor's broken 'Gate of Life' formation by playing it as a Go board, with Tu Fei and Li Heishui placing the stones. Hei Huang's throw scatters them: Pang Bo lands in the Central States and Tu Fei in the Northern Plains.
